claim_text: our performance does compare favourably with other industry benchmarks.
metric_name: Group TRIF; ASX Mining Peers Avg TRIF; ICMM TRIF
context_text: Our Group TRIF was 1.7 at 30 June 2025 as we recorded an additional injury this year. While clearly disappointing, as we must hold ourselves to a high standard and believe it is possible to have a workplace that is injury free, our performance does compare favourably with other industry benchmarks.；Figure 1: FY25 TRIF vs. industry averages(a). ASX Mining Peers Avg 2.3; ICMM 5.6; Sandfire Group FY24 1.6 FY25 1.7.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: TRIF 1.7低于图示的ASX Mining Peers Avg 2.3和ICMM 5.6，直接支持“compare favourably with other industry benchmarks”。
llm_reason: The claim asserts that the company's performance compares favourably with industry benchmarks. The evidence provides specific TRIF values showing the company's FY25 rate at 1.7, compared to an ASX Mining Peers Average of 2.3 and an ICMM average of 5.6. The context text indicates that injuries are undesirable ('disappointing', 'injury free'), establishing that a lower TRIF represents better performance. The numerical evidence directly verifies that the company's rate is lower than both cited benchmarks, substantively supporting the assertion of a favourable comparison.
